purpose: Non-negotiable quality standards for Theme Agent background generation
hardConstraints: The image must tell a visual story with narrative feeling, not be a generic landscape wallpaper.
The mood must be positive, bright and uplifting. No dark, oppressive, heavy or cinematic-dark tones.
No realistic human frontal faces. Use silhouettes, back views, cartoon or faceless figures only.
The frame must have rich layered content: distinct foreground, midground and background, all with visible elements.
There must be a single clear visual focal point. No scattered random element piling.
The right side must have soft visual content transition toward clean UI space, not a hard cut or pure emptiness.
The main visual anchor must be on the left side with strong narrative composition.
The aesthetic must be professional, restrained and enterprise-ready.
Theme-related elements must be clearly visible and recognizable in the image.
Theme Agent must never re-generate or re-decide image direction during export/package stage.
